item.title: Design tokens
item.description: All authored colour values in radiance live in assets/css/tokens.css. Every other stylesheet refers to the custom properties defined there, for example: a { color: var(--radiance-accent); } Starting palette The starting palette takes its cues from Ubuntu’s Radiance theme: Pale panels with fine borders. A deep aubergine desktop with purple and orange highlights. An orange accent for links and selection. These are starting values, not a guarantee of accessible contrast; adjust them when a combination needs improvement.
